fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/PDP/NewTruckPdp.cy.js#PDP - NewTruckPdp [mostPopular] [en] — Tata Yodha 2.0 TC-NTPDP-01: Get Offers lead opens on launch for Tata Yodha 2.0
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NTPDP-01
**Title:** Get Offers lead opens on launch for Tata Yodha 2.0
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the New Truck PDP for Tata Yodha 2.0. Confirm the Get Offers lead popup appears on page load with the correct offers title.

**Expected Result:**
User sees “Check Latest Offers on Tata Yodha 2.0” with name, mobile, city fields and a Get Offers button.

**Steps:**
1. Open Tata Yodha 2.0 PDP without dismissing the launch popup
2. Verify Get Offers lead title and fields are visible
